title: LPDDR7 memory controller: adaptive-page mobile controller (bank = {haddr[8] channel, haddr[10:9]}, row = haddr[31:18], storage = 256 columns per channel); a cold bank (hit count 0) that misses is auto-closed after its burst; per-bank refresh; commands leave as framed beats on the 8-bit CA bus

regs.name: CMD
regs.desc: Host command; writing CMD2 sends it (the core takes it when it is idle and no refresh is due)

fdesc.hcmd: 1 ACT, 2 RD, 3 WR, 4 PRE; other codes are no-ops
fdesc.haddr: host address (bank, row and column fields below)

fields.desc: word of the last RD, valid once RD_DONE is set

irqs.name: RD_DONE
irqs.desc: a RD finished; RDATA holds its word

notes: ck_t, ck_c, cke, ca, cs_n, dq and dqs are the DRAM pins and trace_valid, trace_cmd and trace_addr the command trace (one clock before each command on the pins); they pass through unchanged.

Address map and behaviour of the core: adaptive-page mobile controller (bank = {haddr[8] channel, haddr[10:9]}, row = haddr[31:18], storage = 256 columns per channel); a cold bank (hit count 0) that misses is auto-closed after its burst; per-bank refresh; commands leave as framed beats on the 8-bit CA bus.
The core's own verification (pin-level checker, 100% coverage) is tb/cov/LPDDR7_sva.sv with tb/LPDDR7_tb.sv; this wrapper test drives the core only through the registers.
